title: Drive Broker / Claim atomico
proves: The connected Drive transport can carry a minimal WorkBlock and durable RETURN.
Two concurrent writes requiring the same Google Docs revision did not both succeed.
Revision preconditions can serve as a provisional optimistic-exclusion primitive.
does_not_prove: Two independent ChatGPT chats can autonomously claim work.
Lease expiry and generation fencing work.
The mechanism scales to many blocks or many workers.

failed_attempts.reason: Connector database initialization failed with ECONNREFUSED before migration could be applied.

next_experiment.objective: Use two independent ChatGPT chats against one READY block and verify that exactly one claim is accepted.
